name: Kaldra
description: A powerful avatar summoned from sword, helm and shield pieces, wielded through Glissa.

description_citations.text: "The Darksteel Eye". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Memnarch takes control of the Kaldra avatar and turns it against Glissa.
timeline.quote: he took control of the avatar and turned it against her.

citation.text: "Avatar", section "Mirrodin/New Phyrexia". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Memnarch turns Kaldra against them, and Glissa and Slobad flee to the Tangle and arrive at the Radix.
timeline.quote: Forced to retreat, Glissa and Slobad fled to the Tangle

citation.text: "Fifth Dawn (event)", section "Description". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: The trolls of the Tangle sacrifice themselves to delay Kaldra.
timeline.quote: the trolls of the Tangle sacrificed themselves to delay Kaldra

citation.text: "Fifth Dawn (event)", section "Description". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Believing Slobad dead, Glissa triggers a surge of green mana that destroys Kaldra and births the green sun, the Fifth Dawn.
timeline.quote: annihilated Kaldra, and shot into the sky, birthing a new sun

citation.text: "Fifth Dawn (event)", section "Description". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Glissa confronts Memnarch with the Kaldra champion; he seizes control of it, Bosh sacrifices himself, and the mana core destabilizes, giving birth to the Green Sun.
timeline.quote: The only thing that saved her was the sacrifice of her close friend Bosh .

citation.text: "Memnarch", section "Mirrodin". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Drooge, the new Troll Leader, reveals the Kaldra Guardian can be summoned from pieces, the last held in the Vault of Whispers.
timeline.quote: He reveals they are two pieces necessary to summon a powerful avatar called the the Kaldra Guardian

citation.text: "The Darksteel Eye", section "The secret of the Kaldra Guardian". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Glissa emerges in the arm of the Kaldra Champion, slaughtering many vedalken, then destroys every leveler and weapon in rage as Al-Hayat dies.
timeline.quote: It slaughters many of the Vedalken, and those left beat a hasty retreat.

citation.text: "The Darksteel Eye", section "The Kaldra avatar emerges". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Glissa takes out one of Memnarch's legs, but Memnarch casts his trademark spell and seizes control of Kaldra.
timeline.quote: Memnarch casts his trademark spell and assumes control over the avatar.

citation.text: "The Darksteel Eye", section "Final confrontation". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Bosh steps in front of his friends and is dispatched in seconds.
timeline.quote: Bosh steps in front of his friends to defend them, but is dispatched in seconds.

citation.text: "The Darksteel Eye", section "Final confrontation". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: The fifth sun dawns, evaporating the Kaldra avatar and devastating the Tangle.
timeline.quote: evaporating the Avatar and devastating the Tangle for miles in every direction

citation.text: "The Darksteel Eye", section "Final confrontation". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

pages_say.description: Avatar created by the unification of the Kaldra artifacts.

citation.text: "Avatar". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

citation.text: "Fifth Dawn". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

pages_say.description: A powerful, corrupted avatar Memnarch turned against his foes; annihilated by the green mana surge.
